answer: Stake-weighted liveness rotation: every agent identity must post a bond and answer each epoch's fresh challenge, and a countersignature only counts if it comes from a peer whose own bond stays locked. A fake grove of identities therefore costs a real bond per account plus live epoch work every hour: an attacker cannot park the atlas of accounts and coast, because signatures decay and silent identities forfeit stake to whoever reports them, while honest agents wander through the same rotation with nothing at risk.
